notes: Switching to USB used to say it was switching and then go silent, whether it had worked or not. Wi-Fi and Anywhere both confirm when they connect, and USB now does too. Restarting UseAlibi could close the window and never bring it back, leaving you to reopen it yourself; it now closes properly and the new copy takes over in a couple of seconds. When connecting from anywhere failed, UseAlibi blamed your iPhone for not being on the tailnet no matter what had actually gone wrong: whether Tailscale was not installed, was installed but not running, or your iPhone simply was not connected at that moment. Each of those now says what it is, and where UseAlibi cannot tell, it says what to check instead of guessing. Check my setup no longer hedges on a step that passed: a green result states what is true and nothing more.
